maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is mainly hotel room rentals, food and beverage at owned Hilton, Marriott and Hyatt-branded hotels, not repair or replacement work.

publicly_funded.reason: Guests are leisure travelers, business travelers and groups paying privately; no government payer dominates.

serial_acquirer.reason: Lodging REIT with 29 hotels growing via operations and capital recycling, including selling assets; acquisitions are only occasional.

mission_critical.reason: Hotel guests can easily switch to other hotels; rooms are a largely interchangeable service bought on price and location.
